description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
>*   If no **Overview** page or ID is generated for your instance, you do not need to configure this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

description.en:
The topics to subscribe to. You can subscribe to a maximum of 10 topics.

The operation permission for the topic must be **subscribe** or **publish and subscribe**.

title.en: Subscribe a Specified Device to a Topic

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
- 待订阅Topic所属设备，必须已经接入物联网平台并激活在线。
- 调用本接口仅订阅指定设备的Topic，且单次调用最多订阅10个Topic。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
- The device to which the topic belongs must already be connected to the IoT Platform and activated online.
- This API allows you to subscribe only the specified device to topics, and you can subscribe to a maximum of 10 topics per call.

## Queries Per Second (QPS) Limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 per Alibaba Cloud account.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot subscribe-topic --iot-instance-id iot-06000 --product-key a1Q5XoY000 --device-name device1 --topic example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot SubscribeTopic --region cn-hangzhou --Topic.1 'example-string' --IotInstanceId 'iot-06000' --ProductKey a1Q5XoY000 --DeviceName device1
